question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn and plugin-owned until a broader scheduled-job model override contract lands?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested task-level model boundary, but adding it changes public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, model/provider precedence, and session-state behavior; automation should not choose that API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently run as one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task model field with explicit split/group semantics and compatibility tests.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 as the canonical scheduled model override track and avoid a separate heartbeat-specific routing syntax for now.

recommendation.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently run as one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is mainly product/API scope, and steipete has the strongest history signal around the plugin model-routing seam and prior ClawHub boundary decisions.
